analysis_packet.certificate: Source-complete analysis only: the anchor supplies inherited executable behavior, the contract and constraints supply binding legality obligations, and the candidate hypothesis supplies the proposed provenance-and-amendment topology; no score or evaluator evidence is available.

exact_actions.action: Use every witness and obligation to produce one complete executable policy capsule; mark unresolved tradeoffs explicitly and attach their source provenance.
Preserve all settled interface, safety, legality, visibility, adaptation, and provenance commitments; amend only o_object_byte_tradeoff or o_regret when visible evidence supports the amendment.
Do not infer scores, hidden traces, evaluator behavior, benchmark details, or majority/median outcomes; emit no policy from this analysis stage.

obligations.norm: Implement Policy(capacity_bytes) and access(key, size, now) with the required return type.
Never exceed nonnegative capacity; handle zero-capacity and oversized objects without retaining invalid residents.
Return only unique integer keys that are currently cached and are evicted by the request.
Use only current policy state and the current access tuple; do not use hidden traces, reference implementations, oracle decisions, benchmark paths, networking, subprocesses, or non-stdlib packages.
Retain online mechanisms supporting scan resistance and phase-shift adaptation, including evidence-sensitive recency/frequency behavior where compatible with legality.
Balance object hit rate and byte hit rate without violating capacity or eviction legality.
Reduce regret against an offline optimum using only online heuristics, without claiming measured improvement because scores and traces are withheld.
Bind all settled source-supported decisions coherently before the terminal call and preserve their provenance.
Permit terminal amendments only when tied to explicitly unresolved obligations and supported by directly visible provenance; do not redesign settled commitments.
